item.title: Donald Trump Humiliates Himself On Iran
item.description: Donald Trump has backed off of his threat of a large air attack against Iran, and is instead considering a targeted strike to serve as a warning that the regime must leave power.

item.title: Trump Sets A Stunning Second Term Disapproval Record Before The State Of The Union
item.description: Trump will head into the first State Of The Union of his second term as the least popular second term president of this century.

item.title: Senate Democrats Sink Trump By Announcing They Will Block Any Extension Of His Tariffs
item.description: Senate Democrats announced that there will be no extension of Trump's Section 122 tariffs, as they will block any effort to go beyond the 150 day limit.

item.title: Dozens Of Democrats Are Not Going To Trump's SOTU
item.description: House and Senate Democratic leadership have told Democrats that they can attend the SOTU or they can go do something else. Dozens of Democrats are choosing something else.

item.title: Things Are So Bad That Karoline Leavitt Tried To Gaslight America into believing that Biden Was President Last Year
item.description: White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt tried to claim that Donald Trump wasn't president in 2025, as she blamed Joe Biden for Trump's affordability crisis.

item.title: DOJ Under Investigation For Removing Epstein Files Related To Trump Sexual Assault Allegation
item.description: The FBI interviews of a woman who accused Donald Trump of sexually abusing her when she was 13 years old were illegally removed from the Epstein files and House Oversight Democrats are investigating.

item.title: Trump Mocks Struggling Americans As His SOTU Totally Backfires
item.description: Instead of admitting the reality that too many Americans are economically struggling right now, Donald Trump spun a delusional tale of winning that caused his State Of The Union to backfire.

item.title: Rachel Maddow Brutally Fact Checks Trump's State Of The Union
item.description: MS NOW's Rachel Maddow delivered a devastating fact check of Donald Trump's State Of The Union.

item.title: Trump State Of The Union Flops Even With Republicans
item.description: Trump's speech was such a dud that even among a poll of SOTU watchers that was heavily Republican, the president's address got relatively low marks.

item.title: Mike Johnson Promises That Trump's Presidency Will End If Democrats Win Back The House
item.description: Republicans have come up with some very strange messaging by incentivizing Americans to vote against Republicans by promising that a Democratic victory will end the Trump presidency.
